kind: Source-backed metadata contract for actual native capture; no additional numerical approval

fields.name: Median weekly earnings from paid employment, all groups
fields.population_group: People in paid employment (wages and salaries and/or self-employment) within the HLFS income survey population: non-institutionalised people aged 15 years and over who usually live in New Zealand. Total selected ethnic groups, regions, sexes and ages.
fields.period_convention: June-quarter weekly-income snapshot collected during April–June; self-employment questions cover the preceding 12 months. Not annual earnings.
fields.limitations: Paid-employment earnings are not interchangeable with the wages-and-salaries-only headline or household income. Do not multiply the weekly snapshot by 52 to imply annual earnings.

fields.population_group: People aged 15 years and over at the start of the tax year, with a valid IRD identifier and non-zero covered taxable income. Covered sources include employment, self-employment and specified transfers; not all residents or all possible income sources.
fields.period_convention: Tax year ended 31 March: 1 April of the preceding year through 31 March of the labelled year. People counted over the year, not a quarterly job snapshot.
fields.limitations: Covered taxable income excludes some income sources, including rental and investment income. The latest annual year is provisional until the next annual release; empty source attributes do not establish final status. The two annual numerical reference cells remain independently unverified.

LEED_AP1_001.note: Metadata contract does not supply a numeric reference. Quarterly exact CSV comparison is checked separately; two annual numerical cells remain unresolved.

fields.population_group: People aged 15 years and over at the start of the tax year whose main annual earnings source was wages and salaries or self-employment; valid IRD identifier and non-zero covered income.
fields.period_convention: Tax year ended 31 March: 1 April of the preceding year through 31 March of the labelled year. Gross annual earnings across all jobs, not a full-year-worker requirement.
fields.limitations: Total earnings combine wages and salaries with self-employment, including negative self-employment; not all taxable income or wages alone. The latest annual year is provisional until the next annual release; empty source attributes do not establish final status. This annual numerical reference cell remains independently unverified.

LEED_AP1_002.note: Metadata contract does not supply a numeric reference. Quarterly exact CSV comparison is checked separately; two annual numerical cells remain unresolved.

fields.population_group: Full-quarter PAYE jobs: employer–employee pairs for people aged 15 years and over with valid IRD identifiers, continuous throughout the reference quarter. Social-assistance payments are excluded; some working proprietors taxed at source cannot be separated.
fields.period_convention: Calendar quarter identified by its ending month; 202506 covers 1 April–30 June 2025. Gross earnings include lump sums and describe jobs, not individual people or annual income.
fields.limitations: All full-quarter jobs, not only continuing jobs or new hires. Published earnings use confidentiality rounding to base 10 or 100. Quarterly figures may be revised for two subsequent quarters; no final status is inferred from empty attributes or undisplayed export flags.

LEED_Q1W_001.note: Metadata contract does not supply a numeric reference. Quarterly exact CSV comparison is checked separately; two annual numerical cells remain unresolved.
